speaker: Alicia
original_jp: あの…なぁ…
original_en:
Umm...
So...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …何ですか？
original_en: Sorry.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …先に言えよ
original_en: Uh, you go ahead.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 俺はオーディンを倒す
original_en: I-I'm going after Odin.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …驚かないのか？
original_en: You don't seem surprised.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私も同じ事を言おうと思っていました
original_en: Actually, I was going to say the same thing.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …そうか
original_en: Really?

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: でも どのように？でも どうやって？
original_en:
But, what should we do?
But, how do we do it?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 俺は〓グドラシルの頂上へ行くそこで全ての〓〓を得て神になる
original_en:
I'm going to the top of Yggdrasil. I'll
attain the knowledge to become a god
there.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 知ってるだろ？ アスガルドを〓む世界の創造の源になってる樹だ
original_en:
You know it, right? The tree of creation
for all the realms, including Asgard.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: オーディンも昔は ハーフエルフの肉体を持つだけの下〓神だったんだ…
original_en:
There was once a time when Odin was a
lesser deity. He had the body of a half elf.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: あいつにできた事ならきっと俺にだってできる…
original_en:
I've thought about it for a long time,
but now I'm determined to do it.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …あいつの横暴は もう許せない！
original_en: I'm not taking any more of his tyranny!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …そんな事が！？
original_en: Can you really do that?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: シルメリアも認めてたじゃないか！俺は〓上の空論で終わらせない！
original_en:
Even Silmeria admitted it! It's not a
fantasy. I'm going to do it.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私も一緒に行かせてください！
original_en: Neither am I. Let me go with you!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私はドラゴンオーブを取り返す事でオーディンを倒すつもりでした
original_en:
I was planning to defeat Odin by taking
back the Dragon Orb.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: でも そのためにどうしたらいいか私にはわからないんです…
original_en:
But I don't know how. I can't do it on
my own.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: あなたに… 頼るしか…
original_en: I need you...to help me...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …無理だな
original_en: No chance.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 人間は〓グドラシルへは入れないんだ
original_en: Because humans can't enter Yggdrasil.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: こればっかりはどうにもならないだろ…
original_en:
Sorry, there's just no getting around
that.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …もう 普通の人間なんだよ
original_en: Look, you're a normal human being now.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: どうして！？
original_en: Why not!?

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: でも 光子だって撃てるし <PART> ――
original_en: But I can still project photons!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: オブシェクトリーディングはできないんじゃないか？
original_en:
Even so, you can't read objects, can
you?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: じゃあな アリーシャ…
original_en: Take care, Alicia.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: アスガルドへは 精霊の森の奥にあるビフレストの〓を通る事になる
original_en:
To reach Asgard, I'll have to pass
through the gates of Bifrost in the
heart of the Forest of Spirits.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …行けるところまでだけでも一緒に行こうか
original_en:
Why don't we go together, at least as
far as we can.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …わかった 先に言うよ
original_en: Alright, I'll go first.
